## Qwen 3 235B A22B Instruct 2507 API {#qwen-3-235b-a22b-instruct-2507-api}

### 如何使用 Qwen 3 235B A22B Instruct 2507 API {#how-to-use-the-qwen-3-235b-a22b-instruct-2507-api}

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen3-235b-a22b-instruct-2507",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
